description: Documentation for the five LSP-family built-ins. The entries are under `builtin-ops`, not `ops`, because this preset documents ops it does not define: they dispatch from core and run whether or not it is loaded. Loading it is what makes `ops`, `ops:full` and `help:OP` answer for them. Four of the five reach a language server through the `mcp` block, so a repo with none configured can leave this unlisted and keep the bytes.
requires: an LSP server declared in .supertool.json's mcp block (docs/mcp-integration.md)

workspace.description: One-shot IDE-style view: file + symbols + validators + siblings + git + references + tests. Opt-in (heavy). Use for first-touch on unfamiliar files.

resolve.description: Symbol → file. LSP via mcp.tools.resolve when configured, else heuristic glob.

hover.description: LSP hover: type + docs for SYMBOL.

rename.description: LSP workspace rename. Safer than sed.
